subject: Files
notes: kb/Work PB284: PROSE-PARAGRAPH row. §9.1.16 paragraph 1 names the capability (controlling concurrent access to logical records of a shared file) and the two modes AUTOMATIC and MANUAL, single or multiple record. The numbered rules that state each mode are all CONFORMS with their own witnesses: GR-12.4.5.9.4-4 (AUTOMATIC), -5 (MANUAL), -6 (single), -7 (multiple) and GR-12.4.5.9.4-8. Read: DataBinder.MapLockMode maps the LOCK MODE clause to the two modes and the two multiplicities and FileRegistry.ReadSetsRecordLock applies the mode. || editions 2002,2014,2023 (kb/Work PB284): record locking and the sharing/locking I-O statuses are decided at 2002 for the sibling rows GR-9.1.15-1..3, GR-9.1.13.8-1 and GR-9.1.13.9-1 (kb/Work PB3173), and this paragraph states the same facility.
